sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢一个锅搞定的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 纽约时报，庆祝175周年，陪伴你理解世界，充分过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，网址为 nytimes.com 键入斜杠 subscribe。

sentences.en: This is Christina Goldbaum.
sentences.zh: 我是克里斯蒂娜·戈德鲍姆。

sentences.en: I'm in Damascus, capital of Syria right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在在叙利亚首都大马士革。

sentences.en: And I'm walking through a prison that's underneath one of the intelligence branches in the capital.
sentences.zh: 我正走在一座监狱里，它位于首都其中一个情报分支机构的下方。

sentences.en: There are these three solitary confinement rooMs.
sentences.zh: 这里有三间单人禁闭室。

sentences.en: And etched onto the walls are messages from prisoners who were held here.
sentences.zh: 墙上刻着被关押在这里的囚犯留下的信息。

sentences.en: One of the messages says, I love you, mom.
sentences.zh: 其中一条信息写着：妈妈，我爱你。

sentences.en: There are others that are praying to God.
sentences.zh: 还有一些人在向上帝祈祷。

sentences.en: And there's also an etching of a mosque.
sentences.zh: 还有一个清真寺的刻痕。

sentences.en: What's inside that folder?
sentences.zh: 那个文件夹里是什么？

sentences.en: He's reading.
sentences.zh: 他在阅读。

sentences.en: And earlier, as we were going through the building, we found a folder with pictures of what looked like prisoners who had been tortured and killed.
sentences.zh: 此前，当我们穿过大楼时，我们发现了一个文件夹，里面有看起来像是遭到酷刑虐待和杀害的囚犯的照片。

sentences.en: This is like a report for the death.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一份死亡报告。

sentences.en: You know, when we first arrived in Syria, just a day after the rebels took the country, there was a lot of celebration, a lot of people out on the streets,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们刚到达叙利亚时，就在叛军夺取该国政权仅一天后，有许多庆祝活动，很多人走上街头，

sentences.en: finally feeling this taste of freedom.
sentences.zh: 终于感受到了自由的味道。

sentences.en: And as the week has gone on and we've come to more and more of these prisons and torture facilities,
sentences.zh: 随着这一周的过去，我们走访了越来越多这样的监狱和酷刑设施，

sentences.en: it's just clear how just how much of a reckoning the country is going to have to go through now to confront and reconcile with all of the horrors that happened over the past couple decades.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这个国家现在必须经历多么痛苦的清算，才能去面对和调解过去几十年发生的所有恐怖事件。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自纽约时报，我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: After the fall of Bashar al-Assad and the opening up of Syria, tens of thousands of people were released from prisons across the country.
sentences.zh: 在巴沙尔·阿萨德倒台和叙利亚开放后，全国各地的监狱释放了数万名人员。

sentences.en: Many had been locked away for years.
sentences.zh: 许多人被关押了多年。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Christina Goldbaum takes us inside one of those prisons and tells us the story of a man who made it out.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事克里斯蒂娜·戈德鲍姆带我们走入其中一座监狱，并给我们讲述了一个成功逃出生天的男人的故事。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月17日，星期二。

sentences.en: Christina, what was it like when you first got to Syria?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，你刚到叙利亚时是什么感觉？

sentences.en: So my colleagues and I drove into Syria towards the capital, Damascus, 24 hours after the rebels had seized the country.
sentences.zh: 我和同事驱车前往叙利亚首都大马士革，那是叛军夺取国家控制权24小时后。

sentences.en: And the highway was filled with these very surreal scenes.
sentences.zh: 高速公路上充满了这种非常超现实的景象。

sentences.en: Here, general security, usually.
sentences.zh: 这里通常是国家安全部门。

sentences.en: Wow, this is, they used to stop on Syria.
sentences.zh: 哇，这是，他们以前在叙利亚设立的检查站。

sentences.en: There were checkpoints where usually you would spend hours being interrogated by police officers and security forces that had been completely abandoned.
sentences.zh: 这里有检查站，通常你要花几个小时接受警察和安全部队的审讯，而现在这些地方已经完全被遗弃了。

sentences.en: We saw posters of Bashar al-Assad that used to be ubiquitous, that had been torn down and either ripped apart or burned.
sentences.zh: 我们看到巴沙尔·阿萨德的海报——曾经无处不在的海报——被撕下来，要么被扯碎，要么被烧毁。

sentences.en: And we also began to see, the closer we got to the capital, signs of the rebels who had entered the city.
sentences.zh: 而且随着我们越来越靠近首都，我们也开始看到进入这座城市的叛军的痕迹。

sentences.en: They were driving these cars that had been painted in this kind of beige mud, almost like a makeshift camouflage from their rapid offensive towards the capital.
sentences.zh: 他们开着涂有这种米色泥土的汽车，几乎就像是为了他们向首都的快速进攻而仓促拼凑的伪装。

sentences.en: And then we saw people from Damascus who were out on the streets.
sentences.zh: 然后我们看到大马士革的人们走上街头。

sentences.en: They were putting their fingers in a V in the air, signifying victory.
sentences.zh: 他们把手指在空中比成V字，象征着胜利。

sentences.en: And they were cheering on the rebels as they drove past them to celebrate this incredible moment in the country's history.
sentences.zh: 当叛军开车经过时，他们为叛军欢呼，以庆祝这个国家历史上这个不可思议的时刻。

sentences.en: But for a lot of people here, that moment is also about finally getting answers.
sentences.zh: 但对这里的许多人来说，那个时刻也意味着终于能够得到答案。

sentences.en: The Assad government had set up this vast network of detention facilities and prisons and torture chambers that had swallowed up tens of thousands of people across the country.
sentences.zh: 阿萨德政府建立了一个庞大的拘留设施、监狱和酷刑室网络，吞噬了全国数万名男女老少。

sentences.en: And for years, this was a complete black box.
sentences.zh: 多年来，这是一个完全的黑箱。

sentences.en: People would disappear into the system and their families would have no idea what happened to them, where they went, or whether or not they were still alive.
sentences.zh: 人们在这个系统中消失，他们的家人完全不知道他们发生了什么，他们去了哪里，或者他们是否还活着。

sentences.en: But now, with the fall of that government, suddenly people hoped for answers.
sentences.zh: 但现在，随着那个政府的倒台，人们突然燃起了获得答案的希望。

sentences.en: And as we were driving through the city, we saw a huge convoy of cars going to the epicenter of that system, a prison called Sadnaya,
sentences.zh: 当我们驾车穿过城市时，我们看到一大车队汽车开往那个系统的核心，一座名为赛德纳亚的监狱，

sentences.en: which is one of the most notorious in all of Syria.
sentences.zh: 这是整个叙利亚最臭名昭著的监狱之一。

sentences.en: And my colleague, Huayda Saad, and I joined them as they went on that journey.
sentences.zh: 我的同事瓦伊达·萨ad和我加入了他们的这趟旅程。

sentences.en: As we were driving towards the prison, you can see leading to the prison, there's this massive convoy of cars, all people who are trying to get there.
sentences.zh: 当我们开车驶向监狱时，你可以看到通往监狱的路上有一支庞大的车队，全都是试图赶到那里的人。

sentences.en: We got caught in this traffic because there were thousands of people on Monday morning trying to get there.
sentences.zh: 我们陷入了交通堵塞，因为星期一早上有成千上万的人试图赶到那里。

sentences.en: We ended up getting out of our car with a lot of other people and just walking down the road for about an hour until we reached the outskirts of the prison.
sentences.zh: 我们最终和其他许多人一起下了车，沿着大路步行了大约一个小时，直到到达监狱的边缘。

sentences.en: We then walked with people up this kind of footpath that led up the hillside and to the prison gates.
sentences.zh: 然后我们和人们一起沿着一条通往山坡和监狱大门的小路走去。

sentences.en: Let's go.
sentences.zh: 我们走。

sentences.en: Let's try.
sentences.zh: 我们试一试。

sentences.en: Let's try.
sentences.zh: 我们试一试。

sentences.en: People inside were in an absolute frenzy.
sentences.zh: 里面的人陷入了绝对的狂热中。

sentences.en: There were these crowds of people cramming into different cells.
sentences.zh: 有一群群的人挤进不同的牢房。

sentences.en: My brother-in-law, he's been in prison 2012.
sentences.zh: 我的连襟，他从2012年就被关在监狱里。

sentences.en: They were screaming the names of their relatives who had been lost into this prison.
sentences.zh: 他们大声喊着在座监狱中失踪的亲戚的名字。

sentences.en: Some of them had printout photos of their sons or brothers or husbands and were shoving them in people's faces, asking, have you seen this person?
sentences.zh: 他们有的人拿着打印出来的儿子、兄弟或丈夫的照片，硬塞到别人的脸前，问，你见过这个人吗？

sentences.en: Have you seen this person?
sentences.zh: 你见过这个人吗？

sentences.en: And walking around, there were these quiet testimonies of what life was like inside this prison.
sentences.zh: 四处走动时，能看到关于这座监狱内部生活的无声证言。

sentences.en: There were feces across the floor and messages scrawled into the walls, some of which were begging for death rather than staying there.
sentences.zh: 地板上到处都是粪便，墙上胡乱涂写着一些信息，其中一些甚至在乞求死亡，也不愿留在那里。

sentences.en: And a lot of prisoners had escaped on Sunday morning after the government fell.
sentences.zh: 许多囚犯在周一早上政府倒台后逃走了。

sentences.en: But there were still thousands of others that families suspected of being in Sednaya who were still unaccounted for.
sentences.zh: 但家属怀疑被关在赛德纳亚的其他人中，还有成千上万的人下落不明。

sentences.en: And so these families were going around the prison looking for any kind of scraps of information, any clues as to where their relatives were.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些家属在监狱里四处搜寻任何零星的信息，寻找关于他们亲属下落的任何线索。

sentences.en: What's over here?
sentences.zh: 这里有什么？

sentences.en: This is another section of the prison.
sentences.zh: 这是监狱的另一个区域。

sentences.en: Let's look.
sentences.zh: 我们看看。

sentences.en: You know, one of the first rooms that we walked into looked like maybe it had been an electrical room in the prison.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们走进的第一个房间看起来可能是监狱里的配电室。

sentences.en: And we came across one guy there who had a shovel in hand.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里遇到一个手里拿着铁锹的家伙。

sentences.en: What is he doing?
sentences.zh: 他在干什么？

sentences.en: And he was knocking against the wall and the floor,
sentences.zh: 他正敲击着墙壁和地板，

sentences.en: trying to hear an echo that maybe would signal there was something hollow underneath, maybe a room beneath the floor.
sentences.zh: 试图听到回声，这可能预示着底下有什么中空的东西，也许地板下面有一个房间。

sentences.en: He can see wires here, but where these wires are going?
sentences.zh: 他在这里能看到电线，但这些电线通向哪里？

sentences.en: He started also kind of pulling apart the wires, saying, you know, where does this go?
sentences.zh: 他也开始扯开电线，说道，你知道，这通向哪里？

sentences.en: You know, again, thinking that maybe it led to something underneath the prison, some cells that were there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，再次认为它可能通往监狱底下的某种东西，那里的一些牢房。

sentences.en: As we stepped into another room, there was also a woman who seemed to be just convinced that she was hearing voices on the other side of a wall.
sentences.zh: 当我们走入另一个房间时，还有一个女人，她似乎坚信自己听到墙的另一边有人声。

sentences.en: And she was trying to get the guys around her who had these pickaxes to tear through it.
sentences.zh: 她正试图让她周围拿着鹤嘴锄的男人们砸穿这堵墙。

sentences.en: Because she was saying that she heard voices there, she heard them there.
sentences.zh: 因为她说她在那儿听到了声音，她在那里听到了。

sentences.en: She was looking for her son, who had gone missing 12 years ago.
sentences.zh: 她在寻找12年前失踪的儿子。

sentences.en: At one point, people believed that maybe there were hidden cells, like three stories underground.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，人们相信可能存在隐藏的牢房，比如地下三层。

sentences.en: And so they started picking up pickaxes and hammers and shovels and just tearing into the floors.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始拿起鹤嘴锄、锤子和铁锹，猛砸地板。

sentences.en: Trying to find any kind of shaft or opening or room that might have been hidden and people were maybe stuck inside.
sentences.zh: 试图找到任何可能被隐藏、人们可能被困在里面的竖井、开口或房间。

sentences.en: And as they were doing that, this kind of massive crowd started forming around them.
sentences.zh: 当他们这么做时，周围开始聚集起一大群人。

sentences.en: Because people thought that maybe they had discovered something.
sentences.zh: 因为人们以为他们可能发现了什么。

sentences.en: They had discovered a secret door or a secret stairwell.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了一扇秘密门或一个秘密楼梯间。

sentences.en: And they wanted to get a glimpse of what was underneath.
sentences.zh: 他们想看一眼下面是什么。

sentences.en: Backward, move backward, let us work.
sentences.zh: 往后退，往后退，让我们工作。

sentences.en: And the few rebels who were there around them were screaming at the crowd, telling them to back up and give them space and let them work.
sentences.zh: 周围仅有的几个叛军对人群大喊大叫，告诉他们后退，给他们空间，让他们工作。

sentences.en: Because it was just such a chaotic scene.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一个极其混乱的场面。

sentences.en: And Christina, did they find anything in all this digging?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，他们在这一通挖掘中找到了什么吗？

sentences.en: So, hours and hours after tearing up this place, the rescue workers who were there said that they didn't think that there were any hidden compartments underneath the prison.
sentences.zh: 因此，在拆毁这个地方几个小时后，现场的救援人员表示，他们认为监狱底下没有任何隐藏的隔间。

sentences.en: And that all the prisoners who were there and who were still alive were released already.
sentences.zh: 而且所有留在那里且仍然活着的囚犯都已经获释了。

sentences.en: But the next morning, there was also news that 38 bodies had been discovered in the prison.
sentences.zh: 但第二天早上，也有消息称在监狱里发现了38具尸体。

sentences.en: And they were brought to a hospital at the center of the city.
sentences.zh: 他们被带到市中心的医院。

sentences.en: So, my colleagues and I went to that hospital and to the morgue, where there were forensic examiners going through each of these corpses.
sentences.zh: 于是，我和同事去了那家医院和太平间，那里有法医在检查每一具尸体。

sentences.en: Trying to find any identifiable symbol, any tattoo, any birthmark, anything.
sentences.zh: 试图找到任何可识别的符号、任何纹身、任何胎记，任何东西。

sentences.en: Every picture has a number.
sentences.zh: 每张照片都有一个编号。

sentences.en: Taking photos of them and then posting them on Telegram so that families could look through and see if they recognized any of these corpses.
sentences.zh: 为他们拍照，然后发布到电报上，以便家属们可以浏览并看看是否能认出这些尸体中的任何一个。

sentences.en: Most of them are dying because of the beating and torture.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数人都是因为殴打和虐待而死的。

sentences.en: The doctors believed that some of those people had died days earlier, but there were others that they thought had been dead for weeks or a month.
sentences.zh: 医生认为其中一些人几天前就已经死亡，但还有一些人他们认为已经死了几周或一个月。

sentences.en: And you could smell that as they opened the kind of tarps and informal body bags they had with this just stench that filled the room.
sentences.zh: 当你掀开他们使用的防水布和简易尸袋时，你能闻到那股充满整个房间的恶臭。

sentences.en: Tons of people started coming there, determined to get a look at these bodies themselves.
sentences.zh: 成群结队的人开始涌向那里，决心自己看一眼这些尸体。

sentences.en: There were just throngs of women and men who were just shoving and trying to get into the examination room itself,
sentences.zh: 到处都是挤来挤去、试图进入检查室的男男女女，

sentences.en: saying that they didn't recognize any of the photos and they wanted to see the bodies themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们认不出任何照片，他们想亲自看看尸体。

sentences.en: And at one point, as the day dragged on, one of the doctors just kind of gave up and said,
sentences.zh: 有一刻，随着时间的流逝，其中一位医生似乎放弃了，说道，

sentences.en: OK, fine, if you want to see these people come in, open the doors.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧，如果你想看这些人，那就进来，把门打开。

sentences.en: And this massive crowd of people came into this refrigerator room and started opening the tarps of bodies and looking at them in just this kind of horror.
sentences.zh: 这群庞大的人群涌入这个冷藏室，开始掀开尸体的防水布，带着这种恐惧注视着他们。

sentences.en: Some of them had shown signs of what looked to be torture.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人身上显示出似乎是酷刑虐待的迹象。

sentences.en: There were red marks around one of the necks of one of these bodies.
sentences.zh: 其中一具尸体的脖子周围有红色的印记。

sentences.en: Another had kind of puncture wounds that one of the doctors thought were from a hot iron that this person had likely been hit with many times.
sentences.zh: 另一个有一种刺伤的伤口，一位医生认为那是这个人可能多次被热烙铁烫伤造成的。

sentences.en: One of these bodies didn't have a face anymore.
sentences.zh: 其中一具尸体已经没有脸了。

sentences.en: It was just this charred skull, just beyond recognition.
sentences.zh: 只剩下一个焦黑的头骨，面目全非。

sentences.en: It was incredibly intense.
sentences.zh: 这真是太震撼了。

sentences.en: I mean, women were leaving that room in tears and screaming and cursing Assad and asking that he burn in hell.
sentences.zh: 我是说，女性哭泣着离开那个房间，尖叫并诅咒阿萨德，要求他下地狱。

sentences.en: You know, until that point, I think people had really believed that there was a way of finding folks alive, that there were some secret rooms or some other detention facility
sentences.zh: 你知道，直到那一刻，我认为人们真的相信有一种方法可以找到活人，认为有一些秘密房间或其他拘留设施，

sentences.en: or, you know, somewhere where they'd be broken free from.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，某个他们可以被解救出来的地方。

sentences.en: And I think it's one thing to see the scribblings on the wall of this really grim prison.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，看到这座阴暗监狱墙上的涂鸦是一回事。

sentences.en: It's another to see not just that people might have died, but how they died and what they endured before they died.
sentences.zh: 看到人们可能已经死去，以及他们是如何死去的，还有他们在死前忍受了什么，则是另一回事。

sentences.en: But we did meet one family at the prison that day who got some answers.
sentences.zh: 但那天我们在监狱里确实遇到了一家人，他们得到了一些答案。

sentences.en: Their son had been released from Sednaya when the rebels took the city.
sentences.zh: 他们的儿子在叛军攻占这座城市时从赛德纳亚获释了。

sentences.en: And so he was able to tell us the story of life inside the prison for the first time.
sentences.zh: 因此，他得以第一次向我们讲述监狱内部的生活故事。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having us in your house.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你邀请我们去你家。

sentences.en: So his name is Bilal Shahadi.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫比拉尔·沙哈迪。

sentences.en: He's 26 years old.
sentences.zh: 他今年26岁。

sentences.en: And we met him at his house, me and my colleague Rahal Marchand, who was translating, and walked in and sat down on the floor of their living room.
sentences.zh: 我们在他家里见到了他，我和负责翻译的同事拉哈尔·马尔尚，我们走进去，坐在他们客厅的地板上。

sentences.en: There was a small heater there, too, because it was a pretty cold day.
sentences.zh: 那里还有一个小取暖器，因为那天天气挺冷的。

sentences.en: I grew up here in this village, and it was actually good.
sentences.zh: 我在这座村子里长大，其实挺好的。

sentences.en: And he was telling us about how he had grown up in the suburb of the city with a pretty big family.
sentences.zh: 他跟我们讲了他是如何在城市郊区的一个大家庭里长大的。

sentences.en: He's one of four brothers and a number of sisters, too.
sentences.zh: 他是四个兄弟和好几个姐妹之一。

sentences.en: His dad worked selling fresh water to people in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲靠在社区里卖淡水为生。

sentences.en: And, you know, he remembers when he was younger going to these amusement parks in Damascus with his siblings and going swimming and having barbecues on the hillside.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他记得年轻时和兄弟姐妹去大马士革的游乐园，去游泳，在山坡上烧烤。

sentences.en: And this life that felt very peaceful and full of promise for him and his family.
sentences.zh: 那是一种对他和他的家人来说感觉非常和平且充满希望的生活。

sentences.en: But when the war started in 2011, Bilal was in the sixth grade.
sentences.zh: 但当2011年战争爆发时，比拉尔正上六年级。

sentences.en: And his parents got very nervous about everything going on, so they pulled him out of class.
sentences.zh: 他的父母对发生的一切感到非常紧张，于是把他从学校接了回来。

sentences.en: And pretty early on, the war started to take its toll on his family.
sentences.zh: 很早的时候，战争就开始给他的家庭带来苦难。

sentences.en: Two of his older brothers were both arrested by security forces.
sentences.zh: 他的两个哥哥都被安全部队逮捕了。

sentences.en: His dad tried to get both of them back to their families without any luck.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲试图让两人都回到家人身边，但没有成功。

sentences.en: And at one point, he was describing this to me and said how he had asked someone in the security forces for more information on one of his sons,
sentences.zh: 有一次，他向我描述这件事，说他曾向安全部队的一名成员询问他其中一个儿子的更多信息，

sentences.en: and was told that his son would be released in two hours after questioning.
sentences.zh: 并被告知他的儿子在审讯后两个小时就会被释放。

sentences.en: And now he stayed in prison for 14 years.
sentences.zh: 而现在他在监狱里待了14年。

sentences.en: But it has been over a decade since.
sentences.zh: 但这已经是十年多前的事了。

sentences.en: And why were Bilal's brothers arrested?
sentences.zh: 那么比拉尔的兄弟们为什么被捕呢？

sentences.en: So, like a lot of families in Syria, they never actually got a clear answer of what either of the brothers was accused of.
sentences.zh: 所以，像叙利亚的许多家庭一样，他们其实从来没有得到明确的答复，不知道这两兄弟到底被指控了什么。

sentences.en: And that's something that was pretty common under Assad's government.
sentences.zh: 这也是阿萨德政府统治下非常普遍的情况。

sentences.en: These kind of arbitrary arrests where people are picked off the street, thrown into prison,
sentences.zh: 这种随意的逮捕，人们在街上被抓走，扔进监狱，

sentences.en: and families don't know where they went or what happened to them or what the charges against them are.
sentences.zh: 而家属们却不知道他们去了哪里、发生了什么，或者针对他们的指控是什么。

sentences.en: But I think his brother's arrest instilled a lot of fear in him.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他兄弟的被捕在他心中埋下了极大的恐惧。

sentences.en: He was conscripted into the army when he was 18 years old, as men are required to do.
sentences.zh: 他在18岁时被征入军队，就像法律规定男性必须做的那样。

sentences.en: And soon after, when he sees the horrors of the civil war and the risks that Syrian soldiers are facing, he deserts the military and goes back to his family.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，当他看到内战的恐怖以及叙利亚士兵面临的风险时，他逃兵了，回到了家人身边。

sentences.en: But deserting the army is what eventually gets him arrested by the police as well.
sentences.zh: 但当逃兵最终也导致他被警察逮捕。

sentences.en: So, he's moved from detention facility to detention facility and eventually put in a truck with around 150 other people,
sentences.zh: 所以，他从一个拘留所被转移到另一个拘留所，最后被塞进一辆卡车，里面大约有150个人，

sentences.en: all of them with iron cuffs on their wrists tied to each other, and brought to Sadnaya.
sentences.zh: 他们手腕上都戴着铁铐，彼此连在一起，然后被带到了赛德纳亚。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《连线》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是山姆·马祖斯基，我每天都制作拼字游戏和Letterboxd。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像刚才你们听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: So, Christina, this man you met, Bilal, told you about how he got arrested and sent to Sadnaya Prison.
sentences.zh: 那么，克里斯蒂娜，你遇到的这个人，比拉尔，向你讲述了他如何被捕并被送往赛德纳亚监狱的经过。

sentences.en: What did he say about what life was like inside the prison?
sentences.zh: 他对于监狱里的生活是怎么说的？

sentences.en: He described the conditions in the prison as being just absolutely horrifying.
sentences.zh: 他将监狱里的条件形容为简直可怕至极。

sentences.en: He's brought to this cell that's underground and rarely ever sees sunlight again.
sentences.zh: 他被带到这个地下的牢房里，几乎再也见不到阳光。

sentences.en: A spot?
sentences.zh: 一个点？

sentences.en: A tiny hole.
sentences.zh: 一个小洞。

sentences.en: A tiny hole?
sentences.zh: 一个小洞？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There were about 100 other people in the cell with him.
sentences.zh: 他的牢房里大约还有其他100人。

sentences.en: All the men, they have to use one baton inside the room.
sentences.zh: 所有的男人，他们必须在房间里共用一根警棍。

sentences.en: Only one toilet in the corner of the room that all of them had to share.
sentences.zh: 房间角落里只有一个厕所，所有人都要共用。

sentences.en: Bad.
sentences.zh: 太糟了。

sentences.en: The cell always smelled like sewage.
sentences.zh: 牢房里总是弥漫着下水道的气味。

sentences.en: And there was this kind of layer of grime across the floor and the walls.
sentences.zh: 地板和墙壁上覆盖着一层厚厚的污垢。

sentences.en: How much food would they get you?
sentences.zh: 他们给你们多少食物？

sentences.en: He said that usually they would only get one potato for eight people in a day.
sentences.zh: 他说通常八个人一天只能分到一个土豆。

sentences.en: And that they would have to cut up that single potato into tiny portions for everyone who was sharing it with them.
sentences.zh: 他们必须把那个土豆切成小份，分给所有一起分享的人。

sentences.en: In the best way, you will take a bigger slice.
sentences.zh: 用最好的方式，你会拿到更大的一块。

sentences.en: And they barely got any water with that too.
sentences.zh: 他们随之得到的饮用水也少得可怜。

sentences.en: So the people didn't think about anything except the...
sentences.zh: 所以人们脑子里除了……什么都不想

sentences.en: And every morning...
sentences.zh: 而每天早晨……

sentences.en: Okay, every day in our room, they take the names.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们房间里每天都会点名。

sentences.en: The prison guards would come around and do a roll call of everyone in the cell.
sentences.zh: 狱警会过来对牢房里的每个人进行点名。

sentences.en: And when that happened, they had to have their faces against the wall.
sentences.zh: 当这种情况发生时，他们的脸必须贴着墙。

sentences.en: And he never actually saw any of the guards who were there.
sentences.zh: 而且他实际上从未见过任何在那里的狱警。

sentences.en: He only ever heard their voices.
sentences.zh: 他只能听到他们的声音。

sentences.en: And then occasionally, he said often when they were in a bad mood or angry about something, they would drag one of the prisoners out and beat and torture him.
sentences.zh: 然后偶尔，他说通常当他们心情不好或对某事生气时，他们会把其中一个囚犯拖出去殴打和虐待。

sentences.en: Bilal said that occasionally he was the one who was brought out and taken to this room.
sentences.zh: 比拉尔说，偶尔他也会成为被带出来带到这个房间的那个人。

sentences.en: When he's sitting like this...
sentences.zh: 当他这样坐着的时候……

sentences.en: As he was describing this to me, he kind of stood up and bent over, his hands by his ankles.
sentences.zh: 当他向我描述这个时，他站了起来，弯下腰，双手放在脚踝旁。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Sick?
sentences.zh: 有病？

sentences.en: Yeah?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Sick?
sentences.zh: 有病？

sentences.en: Between his legs.
sentences.zh: 在他的双腿之间。

sentences.en: And said that they would usually put an iron rod between his knees.
sentences.zh: 并说他们通常会在他的膝盖之间放一根铁棒。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: And then what happened?
sentences.zh: 然后发生了什么？

sentences.en: And then they would kick him.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会踢他。

sentences.en: They would stomp on his face, and they would hit him in the back.
sentences.zh: 他们会践踏他的脸，还会猛击他的背部。

sentences.en: What were they beating him with?
sentences.zh: 他们用什么打他？

sentences.en: Because it's leather.
sentences.zh: 因为那是皮质的。

sentences.en: Leather.
sentences.zh: 皮质的。

sentences.en: Okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: And he told us that usually when this happened, there would be other guards in the room who would be yelling curses at him and kind of cheering on whoever was actually beating him
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，通常发生这种事时，房间里还会有其他狱警，他们会对他大声咒骂，并为当天真正殴打他的人加油助威。

sentences.en: that day.
sentences.zh: 那天。

sentences.en: And usually other prisoners could hear whoever was being beaten or tortured that day from their cells.
sentences.zh: 通常其他囚犯在他们的牢房里就能听到当天是谁在挨打或受刑。

sentences.en: They could hear the sound of...
sentences.zh: 他们能听到……的声音

sentences.en: They would hear them screaming and crying out for help, and they would know it would come the next time that they were pulled out of the room.
sentences.zh: 他们会听到他们尖叫和哭喊求救，他们会知道下一次轮到自己被拉出房间时也会这样。

sentences.en: How does Bilal describe his mental state through all of this?
sentences.zh: 比拉尔如何描述他经历这一切时的精神状态？

sentences.en: He said it was absolutely unbearable.
sentences.zh: 他说这简直让人无法忍受。

sentences.en: And he spent most of the two years that he was in Sednaya praying to die, because that felt easier than enduring the torture anymore.
sentences.zh: 在赛德纳亚度过的这两年里，他大部分时间都在祈求死去，因为比起继续忍受酷刑，那样感觉更轻松。

sentences.en: And things continued on like that for a while, until about a week and a half ago, when he told me, he started to notice a bit of a change.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样持续了一段时间，直到大约一个半星期前，他告诉我，他开始注意到一些变化。

sentences.en: They came a soldier to our room, and they were afraid.
sentences.zh: 有个士兵来到我们的房间，他们很害怕。

sentences.en: He said it started with the roll calls that they used to do every morning, and typically they would say, roll call you animals, to all of the prisoners in the cell.
sentences.zh: 他说这一切始于他们每天早晨例行的点名，通常他们会对牢房里的所有囚犯说：“点名，你们这群畜生。”

sentences.en: Because he came, he came to our room, and for the first time, he didn't call us animals.
sentences.zh: 因为他来了，他来到了我们的房间，破天荒地没有叫我们畜生。

sentences.en: But then one morning they said, roll call you guys, which just struck him as being a little bit strange.
sentences.zh: 但后来有一天早晨他们说：“点名，伙计们。”这让他觉得有点奇怪。

sentences.en: Somehow they were being more humane to the prisoners all of a sudden.
sentences.zh: 不知何故，他们突然对囚犯更有人情味了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then the next day they asked them, they told him, how are you?
sentences.zh: 然后第二天他们问他们，对他说：“你们好吗？”

sentences.en: How they were in the morning, which he thought was even more strange.
sentences.zh: 早上他们的情况怎么样，他觉得这更奇怪了。

sentences.en: Bilal turned his head.
sentences.zh: 比拉尔转过头。

sentences.en: And he was so surprised that he turned his head around to look at the guard.
sentences.zh: 他太惊讶了，以至于转过头去看着守卫。

sentences.en: He didn't beat him.
sentences.zh: 他没有打他。

sentences.en: But he also wasn't beaten for doing that.
sentences.zh: 但他也没有因为这样做而遭到殴打。

sentences.en: And then the next day, the guard started giving the prisoners small cookies, which he hadn't had in the two years he had been there.
sentences.zh: 然后第二天，守卫开始给囚犯们发小饼干，这是他进监狱两年来从未有过的。

sentences.en: And he told me that as this was happening, he was talking to the other prisoners, trying to figure out what exactly was going on.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，正当这一切发生时，他正在和其他囚犯交谈，试图弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: And the regime made a decision that they will not beat us anymore.
sentences.zh: 政权做出了决定，他们不再殴打我们了。

sentences.en: But they didn't even imagine that they were only days away from walking out the prison's gates and being free.
sentences.zh: 但他们甚至没有想到，他们距离走己监狱大门并重获自由只剩几天时间了。

sentences.en: And then on Saturday night,
sentences.zh: 然后在周六晚上，

sentences.en: He told me, wake up.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，醒醒。

sentences.en: One of his cellmates shook him to wake him up and was telling him that something was going on, that maybe they would be freed.
sentences.zh: 他的一个室友摇醒了他，告诉他有事情正在发生，也许他们就要自由了。

sentences.en: I told him, I want to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，我想睡觉。

sentences.en: Don't lie to me.
sentences.zh: 别骗我。

sentences.en: Why aren't you telling me this?
sentences.zh: 你为什么对我说这个？

sentences.en: And Bilal didn't believe him.
sentences.zh: 比拉尔不相信他。

sentences.en: He told him to leave him alone.
sentences.zh: 他叫他别烦他。

sentences.en: He was asleep.
sentences.zh: 他在睡觉。

sentences.en: He told him, here, listen.
sentences.zh: 他对他说：“听着。”

sentences.en: Allahu Akbar.
sentences.zh: 真主至大。

sentences.en: And they hear Allahu Akbar.
sentences.zh: 他们听到了“真主至大”。

sentences.en: And Bilal hears people shouting, God is great.
sentences.zh: 比拉尔听到人们高喊“真主至大”。

sentences.en: And he realizes that something is going on.
sentences.zh: 他意识到有什么事情正在发生。

sentences.en: And eventually, he pieces together that one of the prison guards had stripped off his uniform, opened one of the cells, dropped the keys, and ran.
sentences.zh: 最终，他拼凑出真相：其中一名狱警脱下了制服，打开了一间牢房，扔下钥匙，然后逃跑了。

sentences.en: And all of the prisoners from that cell had taken the keys, had unlocked the other cells there, and they were rushing out of the doors out of the prison.
sentences.zh: 那个牢房里的所有囚犯都拿了钥匙，打开了那里的其他牢房，他们冲出了门，逃离了监狱。

sentences.en: Cristina, why had the guard done that?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，守卫为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: The officer, the regime officer, he changed his clothes.
sentences.zh: 这个军官，政权军官，他换了衣服。

sentences.en: We don't know for certain, but it seemed like maybe the guard had heard that the rebels were nearing the prison,
sentences.zh: 我们无法百分之百确定，但看起来可能是守卫听说反叛分子正在逼近监狱，

sentences.en: and thought that if he opened the prison cells and wore civilian clothes, he could blend in with prisoners leaving themselves and escape.
sentences.zh: 并认为如果他打开牢房并穿上便服，他就可以混在离开的囚犯中间逃跑。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Okay, so Bilal.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么比拉尔。

sentences.en: So, you go out, you see that everyone is leaving.
sentences.zh: 所以，你走出去，看到每个人都在离开。

sentences.en: Where do you go?
sentences.zh: 你去哪儿？

sentences.en: What did you do?
sentences.zh: 你做了什么？

sentences.en: Harak Tua.
sentences.zh: 哈拉克图阿。

sentences.en: Harak Tua.
sentences.zh: 哈拉克图阿。

sentences.en: So Bilal gets out of his cell.
sentences.zh: 于是比拉尔走出了他的牢房。

sentences.en: He entered the offices for the officers.
sentences.zh: 他进入了军官们的办公室。

sentences.en: He runs to an office within the prison, finds a photo of Bashar al-Assad.
sentences.zh: 他跑进监狱内的一间办公室，找到了一张巴沙尔·阿萨德的照片。

sentences.en: I burned Bashar's pictures.
sentences.zh: 我烧了巴沙尔的照片。

sentences.en: And burns it.
sentences.zh: 并将其烧毁。

sentences.en: And then he walks out of the prison gates.
sentences.zh: 然后他走出了监狱大门。

sentences.en: Okay, and in that moment, how would you describe how you felt?
sentences.zh: 好的，在那一刻，你会如何形容你的感受？

sentences.en: It was a dream.
sentences.zh: 那就像是一场梦。

sentences.en: All is a dream.
sentences.zh: 一切都是梦。

sentences.en: He told me that he felt like he was dreaming this entire time, that he couldn't actually believe that he had been freed.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他觉得自己一直在做梦，简直不敢相信自己真的重获自由了。

sentences.en: How has it been for Bilal to be home?
sentences.zh: 比拉尔回家后的生活怎么样？

sentences.en: I think the past week and a half has been a kind of whirlwind of emotions for Bilal and his family.
sentences.zh: 我认为过去的一个半星期对比拉尔和他的家人来说是一场情感的旋风。

sentences.en: I talked to his mom about this.
sentences.zh: 我跟他的妈妈谈过这件事。

sentences.en: For his mother, when you saw Bilal, tell me about that moment.
sentences.zh: 对于他的母亲来说，当你看到比拉尔时，跟我讲讲那一刻。

sentences.en: It's like a happy, this is the happiness.
sentences.zh: 就像是快乐，这就是快乐。

sentences.en: Crying and happy.
sentences.zh: 又哭又高兴。

sentences.en: On the one hand, they are incredibly grateful and happy and overjoyed that they finally have one of their sons home.
sentences.zh: 一方面，他们无比感激、高兴和狂喜，因为他们终于有一个儿子回到了家中。

sentences.en: That he's okay, that he's with their family, that he's alive.
sentences.zh: 他很好，他和家人在一起，他还活着。

sentences.en: And Bilal himself is overjoyed to be free, to be able to be with his family and be back in his home and not live in the perpetual fear of being beaten or tortured in prison.
sentences.zh: 而比拉尔本人也为重获自由感到狂喜，能够与家人在一起，回到自己的家中，不必再生活在监狱中挨打或受虐的永恒恐惧之中。

sentences.en: But at the same time, I think with every day that's passed since the Assad government fell, his mom, his dad, Bilal, have all realized more and more
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我想自阿萨德政府倒台以来过去的每一天里，他的妈妈、他的爸爸、比拉尔，都越来越意识到

sentences.en: that it's very unlikely his brothers are coming home.
sentences.zh: 他的兄弟们不太可能会回家了。

sentences.en: And a few days after we went to Bilal's home, I talked to his father, who had sent a relative back to Sanaya and he had found a death certificate for one of his sons.
sentences.zh: 在我们去比拉尔家几天后，我采访了他的父亲，他曾派亲戚回过赛德纳亚，并在那里找到了他其中一个儿子的死亡证明。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: But there still isn't any other news.
sentences.zh: 但仍然没有任何其他消息。

sentences.en: Of the other.
sentences.zh: 关于另一个人的。

sentences.en: So they got one answer, but still don't have the other.
sentences.zh: 所以他们得到了一个答案，但仍然没有另一个答案。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: When you talked to Bilal's father, how was he feeling about this?
sentences.zh: 当你采访比拉尔的父亲时，他对此有何感受？

sentences.en: He was incredibly sad and crying.
sentences.zh: 他难过得无以复加，一直在哭泣。

sentences.en: But at the same time, he was talking about how he wanted revenge for what happened to his sons.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他一直在谈论他想为儿子的遭遇复仇。

sentences.en: He told me the first time he went to Sanaya, he wanted to burn it down.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他第一次去赛德纳亚时，他想把它烧成平地。

sentences.en: He wanted to find who did this to them and break their neck.
sentences.zh: 他想找出是谁对他们做出这种事，并扭断他们的脖子。

sentences.en: He wanted some kind of justice for everything that his family had endured.
sentences.zh: 对于家人所遭受的一切，他想要某种程度的正义。

sentences.en: He was also incredibly angry about the fact that he still, even now, doesn't have answers.
sentences.zh: 他也对至今仍然没有答案这一事实感到无比愤怒。

sentences.en: Christina, do they plan on continuing their search in the coming days?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，他们计划在接下来的几天里继续搜寻吗？

sentences.en: They do.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们计划继续。

sentences.en: They have sent relatives back to Sanaya.
sentences.zh: 他们已经派亲属回到了萨纳亚。

sentences.en: They've talked to friends who've gone to other detention facilities and have rifled through the papers there.
sentences.zh: 他们和去过其他拘留设施的朋友交谈过，并在那里的文件中仔细翻找。

sentences.en: I think that until they find something concrete, until they know where their sons were buried, if they're both killed, and can hold them in their arms themselves,
sentences.zh: 我认为，在他们找到确凿证据之前，在他们知道儿子们被埋在哪里（如果他们都被杀害了）并且能亲自把他们抱在怀里之前，

sentences.en: there isn't really a sense of closure.
sentences.zh: 根本谈不上什么真正的释怀。

sentences.en: That's what his father, what his mother kept coming back to, was wanting to have their bodies in their arms to know where they are and to be able to bury them themselves.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲、他的母亲一直反复强调的，就是希望能把他们的遗体抱在怀里，知道他们在哪里，并能亲自安葬他们。

sentences.en: Until that happens, their search will continue.
sentences.zh: 在那之前，他们的搜寻将不会停止。

sentences.en: Christina, thank you.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Monday, the German government collapsed after Chancellor Olaf Scholz lost a no-confidence vote in the country's parliament.
sentences.zh: 周一，在德国总理奥拉夫·朔尔茨在国家议会的不信任投票中落败后，德国政府倒台了。

sentences.en: Scholz was forced to take the unusual step of calling for the vote because his three-party coalition splintered last month,
sentences.zh: 朔尔茨被迫采取了罕见的举措来要求进行这次投票，因为他的三党联合政府上个月分裂了，

sentences.en: leaving him without a parliamentary majority to pass laws or a budget.
sentences.zh: 导致他失去了通过法律或预算所需的议会多数席位。

sentences.en: New elections are slated for late February.
sentences.zh: 新的选举计划于2月下旬举行。

sentences.en: And a judge has rejected the argument made by President-elect Donald Trump that he is protected by presidential immunity when it comes to his conviction in the state of New York.
sentences.zh: 一名法官驳回了当选总统唐纳德·特朗普提出的辩解，即他在纽约州的定罪受到总统豁免权的保护。

sentences.en: Judge Juan Merchan said on Monday that the immunity argument does not apply because the case involves unofficial and personal acts that preceded Trump's first term.
sentences.zh: 法官胡安·梅尔坎周一表示，豁免权论点不适用，因为该案涉及特朗普第一个任期之前的非官方和个人行为。

sentences.en: If the decision withstands the expected appeal, he could become the first felon to serve as president.
sentences.zh: 如果该裁决经受住了预期的上诉，他可能会成为第一位担任总统的重罪犯。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗谢尔·邦贾制作，

sentences.zh: 克莱尔·特内斯凯特、林赛·加里森和斯特拉·陈制作，埃里克·克鲁普克提供了协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Patricia Willans, with help from Lindsay Garrison.
sentences.zh: 节目由帕特里夏·威兰斯编辑，林赛·加里森提供了协助。

sentences.zh: 包含由丹·鲍威尔、

sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢收听的任何地方查找《Wirecutter秀》。
